name: Banh su se
summary: Bánh su sê, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page, is tapioca flour, coconut, mung bean, and pomelo-flower water. The mold is fresh coconut leaf. The page says the shape stands for love and fidelity.
origin: Listed with bánh ít lá gai on that Da Nang page. A street was not printed.
culture: The 16 Apr 2024 page says the coconut-leaf shell stands for love and fidelity.
howToEat: The page describes the cake and does not describe a dip. Check on arrival.
where: The 16 Apr 2024 page does not name a street. Check on arrival.
